introParagraphs: Heroes and Heritage Tours brings Canadian military history to life through carefully researched, small-group journeys across France and Belgium.

From the trenches of Vimy Ridge and the battlefields of Passchendaele to the beaches of Normandy, every tour combines expert interpretation, personal stories and meaningful visits to the places where history happened.
Whether you are following a relative, discovering Canada's wartime story, or visiting these battlefields for the first time, our tours are designed to be informative, personal and unforgettable.

whyUs.heading: Expert Historical Interpretation
whyUs.text: Tours are led by a Canadian battlefield guide specialising in the First World War.

whyUs.heading: Small Groups
whyUs.text: Travel in a comfortable minibus with fewer guests, more conversation and more time at each site.

whyUs.heading: Personal Stories
whyUs.text: History is explained through the experiences of the soldiers who fought there, not only dates and military movements.

whyUs.heading: Carefully Researched Itineraries
whyUs.text: Every route is designed around historical importance, geography and the quality of the guest experience.

whyUs.heading: Family Research
whyUs.text: Guests following a relative can request preliminary research and a personalised battlefield experience.

whyUs.heading: Local Knowledge
whyUs.text: Benefit from years of experience travelling, researching and guiding throughout France and Belgium.

familyTeaserAlt: A guest places a Canadian flag at her relative's grave in a Commonwealth war cemetery
familyTeaserParagraph: Send us your relative's name, and we'll research their service record, the battles they fought in, and the exact ground they stood on, then build it into your tour. Families have found gravesites, uncovered medical histories, and walked the paths their great-grandfathers walked over a century ago.
familyTeaserQuote: He brought my Great Grandfather's war experience to life, and completed my own journey with an emotional trip to my Great Uncle's gravesite.
remembranceParagraphs: Heroes and Heritage Tours is committed to preserving and sharing Canada's military heritage.
Through careful battlefield research and a deep respect for the places we visit, we work to ensure that the stories of Canadian soldiers remain connected to the ground where they served.
remembranceImageAlt: A guest in a preserved trench dugout museum
